name: geo-sleuth
description: An agent skill that finds where a photo was taken — OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery and street view — and shows its work. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot.

capability_evidence.auto-failover: the complete skill folder, including data/ and the helper modules in scripts/.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor

friction.note_en: Turnkey. install via npx one-liner, uvx one-liner; needs git clone (build from source)
friction.note_zh: 开箱即用。可通过 npx one-liner、uvx one-liner 安装；需要 git clone (build from source)

analysis.summary_en: An agent skill that finds where a photo was taken — and shows its work.
highlights: Checkpoints: the 171 sites that pass the horizon test should include intercity bridge segments near the answer; the skyline fit covers 14,372 camera positions, the top 20 lie within 0.1°, a…

Example: examples/desert-roll-fix/ reproduces the fit before and after the roll change on the fixed 12 sites (true site from #8 at 12.0 px to #1 at 6.2 px).
Two runs: the table is the original solve that led to the roll fit (Claude Opus 5.0); the blind re-run came later, with a new agent on Claude Opus 5.5.
analysis.summary_zh_native: 一个 agent skill，能找到照片的拍摄地点——并展示它的推理过程。
highlights_zh: 盲测检查点：青海高压线 5,334 条；terrain.py scan 用默认的 --cluster-km 3.5，14,843 个命中聚成 792 簇；792 簇全部送进 terrain.py fit（分 6 批），山脊拟合之前没有按卫星图排名截断；最好的一处 0.224°，第二 0.357°；再用卫星图在视线方向上找沙丘和营地。
街景核验：match.py 整图排序不理想（盛花期，照片在人行道上拍而街景车走在路中间），于是用 --query-box 0,900,1440,1600 只比树所在的区域，再取 2009 / 2024 两期街景核对石墙、台阶、路灯杆这些不变的地物。
检查点：通过地平线检验的 171 处里应包含答案附近的广清城际桥段；天际线拟合 14,372 个机位，前 20 名相差不到 0.1°，靠"桥左近右远"筛到 22；叠图看前三名；最后用 17 根桥墩的方位线定点。
示例：examples/desert-roll-fix/ 用固定的 12 处复现横滚拟合前后（真值从第 8 名、12.0 px 到第 1 名、6.2 px）。
